Container.Name: DJ Masked
Container.Overview:
A cross-platform Discord music bot with a clean interface. Fork of the original JMusicBot, now maintained and regularly updated. Supports YouTube, SoundCloud, local files, and more. Configuration is done via config.txt - edit it to add your bot token and owner ID.
Note: container runs as non-root user (UID 10001). Make sure your mounted config folder is writable.

Config.Name: Config folder
Config.Description: Folder where config.txt, playlists, and bot files are stored. First run auto-generates default config.txt.
